verdict.rationale: The only documented API credentials are API keys generated in the platform dashboard to manage multiple projects, with no evidence of permission scopes or least-privilege restrictions. Per-action tool selection for agents is an adjacent control over in-product agent behaviour, not scoped API credentials. The embeddable MCP token is a per-user authorization for embedded automations, not documented as a scoped or least-privilege credential an agent can be issued.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
